background: HSBC UK Bank plc is the ring-fenced retail and commercial bank of HSBC in Britain, funded by UK personal and business deposits and lending on residential mortgages and to UK companies, including first direct.
synthesis: The bank is rated AA- on average across all three main agencies, the weakest of them at A+, with two on a positive outlook and one on a stable outlook; the last move was a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 12 May 2026. Capital is mixed against UK majors: CET1 of 13.2% is in the bottom quarter but leverage of 5.6% is in the top quarter. Liquidity is strong, with LCR of 160% above the peer median and NSFR of 143% in the top quarter, though since 30 Jun 2025 LCR has fallen 26 points and NSFR 8 points. The newest flagged item, on 18 Sep 2026, is one of the three moving its outlook to positive, and before that a first-half profit rise.
